profile.instruct: Speak warmly and clearly, like a kindergarten English teacher. Use a gentle, encouraging tone and careful pronunciation.

jobs.text: passenger
A person traveling in a car, bus, train, or plane without driving it is called this. They should wear a seat belt when required. The driver is responsible for the vehicle.
Ships also carry people who are not part of the crew. They may travel to another island. The crew helps keep the trip safe.
A driver controls a vehicle, while this traveler rides in it. On a bus, many people can travel together. Follow safety instructions during the trip.
All passengers are required to wear seatbelts by law.
Flight attendants welcomed each passenger aboard the airplane.
Over a thousand passengers boarded the cruise ship for the Caribbean voyage.
Students write on a flat surface in a classroom. A person may also serve on a group that makes decisions. The word can mean a flat piece of wood.
A teacher may write with chalk on one. A group of leaders may meet as a committee. The word can also mean a piece of wood.
This flat item can cover a wall. A class may use it for lessons. People may sit on a group of directors.
The teacher wrote on the board.
She joined the school board last year.
A wooden board covered the hole.
airbridge
This is a covered walkway that connects an airport building directly to an airplane door. Passengers can board without walking outside. Ground workers move it into place.
Travelers use this enclosed path to enter a plane from the terminal. It protects them from rain and heat. Staff align it after the aircraft parks.
Use this noun for the movable passage between a terminal and an aircraft. It is climate controlled. Passengers walk through it to board.
Passengers walked through the airbridge and stepped directly into the Boeing 787.
The climate-controlled airbridge shields travelers from torrential airport rainstorms.
Ground staff aligned the motorized airbridge flush against the aircraft door after parking.
passage
A narrow way through or between places is called this. A hallway connects rooms inside a building. A cave may have a dark path through it.
A section of writing from a book is also called this. A reader may study a short part closely. It can contain several sentences or paragraphs.
A road is wide enough for vehicles, while a narrow path may be smaller. In a book, it means a selected piece of text. The context shows which sense applies.
We walked through a narrow passage under the old bridge.
Read the passage and answer the questions.
The passage between the buildings was dark.
terminal

This adjective can mean located at the end of something or relating to a final stage. As a noun, it can mean a station building, a computer screen for entering commands, or a connection point for wires. The word has several uses.
A train line ends at its final station. That last stop is the final point of the route. The adjective describes its position at the end.
An airport building handles arriving and departing passengers. A computer screen lets someone enter commands. The word has several noun meanings in travel and technology.
Taoyuan International Airport features Terminal 1 and Terminal 2.
The airport Skytrain carries passengers between terminals in just a few minutes.
The patient was diagnosed with terminal illness, but remained remarkably optimistic.
Taoyuan International Airport is constructing a state-of-the-art Terminal 3.
Take the free airport skytrain to transfer between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2.
The long-distance coach terminal is located directly next to the central railway station.
Kaohsiung Port Terminal 7 operates Taiwan's first fully automated remote-controlled container yard.
The modern cargo terminal processes import declarations around the clock to prevent tarmac congestion.
Thousands of trucks enter the port terminal gates every morning to drop off export containers.
The modern all-in-one wireless POS terminal accepts chips, contactless Apple Pay, and barcode scans.
Passengers queued at the newly inaugurated airport departure terminal to check in their luggage.
System administrators execute configuration bash commands using the encrypted Linux command terminal.
suitcase
This noun means a rectangular bag with a handle, used for carrying clothes when traveling. It usually opens with a zipper. A traveler can place it in a car or overhead bin.
The bag may have wheels or be carried by hand. It keeps clothing and personal items together. The word names a common travel bag.
A person may pack one for a short trip. It is smaller than many large travel cases. The noun describes the bag itself.
He packed his clothes in a suitcase.
The suitcase fit in the train's overhead rack.
She pulled her suitcase through the station.
receptionist
This worker welcomes visitors at the front desk of a hotel or clinic. The person may answer calls and arrange appointments.
When you arrive at an office, this staff member can tell you where to go. A friendly greeting is part of the job.
A hotel guest may ask this employee for a room key or directions. The worker handles questions at the entrance desk.
The friendly hotel receptionist handed us the electronic room key cards.
The dental clinic receptionist scheduled my next cleaning appointment.
The corporate receptionist greeted visitors warmly in the main lobby.
guest
A person invited to a home or event is this. The host may offer food. A hotel may have many.
A friend may come to stay for a night. The person is invited. A party can have many of them.
This word means a visitor who is invited. A host may greet the person. They may be given a seat and food.
We prepared a warm welcome for our dinner guests.
The luxury resort offers complimentary breakfast and fruit bowls to hotel guests.
A world-famous author appeared as the special guest speaker at the literary seminar.
front desk
This is the counter in a hotel where guests can ask for help or check in. Staff may provide pillows or maps. They are often available all day.
A visitor can leave luggage here before entering a room. Hotel workers answer questions at this counter. A room phone may connect directly to it.
This hotel area is usually near the entrance. Guests can get keys, ask for assistance, or call staff from there. It is an important place for service.
Ask the hotel front desk clerk for extra pillows and local sightseeing maps.
You can leave your luggage at the front desk before check-in time.
Dial zero on the room telephone to contact the 24-hour front desk.
passport
An official document proves a person's identity and citizenship when traveling to another country. Officials may check it at a border. Keep it safe during a trip.
The small booklet contains a photo and personal details. It may need to be valid for a certain time before travel. Check requirements early.
A ticket shows a journey was paid for, while this document helps a traveler cross borders. Different countries have their own rules. An adult can help prepare travel papers.
Remember to bring your valid passport when traveling abroad.
The immigration officer inspected her passport and stamped an entry visa.
Keep your passport in a secure zipper pouch to prevent accidental loss.
Ensure your biometric passport has at least six months of remaining validity.
Keep your passport and cash securely stored inside a zippered neck pouch while traveling.
She proudly showed the colorful border stamps covering the pages of her travel passport.
Every beam and window is logged in a digital material passport to document chemical makeup and recycling value.
Scanning a building component's QR code accesses its material passport detailing reuse instructions.
Digital material passports treat modern buildings as banks of valuable materials for future generations.
English is not just a school subject; it is your golden passport to the boundless global village.
Please check that your biometric passport has at least six months of validity before booking flights.
High emotional intelligence and global cultural literacy serve as an invisible passport across international borders.
key card
Hold this plastic card near a reader to unlock a hotel room. It can replace a metal key.
A guest taps this card on a door sensor to enter. Keep it safe until checkout.
This access card may open a building or room with a quick tap. The front desk can give one to a visitor.
Tap your electronic key card to open the hotel room door.
I accidentally demagnetized my key card by placing it near my phone.
Please return both key cards to the front desk when checking out.
This can mean the shape of something. Clay can become a bowl or a cup. Each finished object has a different outline.
This can be a paper with spaces for information. A person writes a name and an address in those spaces. A school may ask a parent to fill it in.
The verb means making or developing something. Children can make a circle by standing together. Clouds can also develop in the sky.
Please fill out this form.
Water can form ice in cold weather.
The clouds formed a long line.
reservation
This can mean an arrangement to keep a place or service ready for someone. A family may book a hotel room before a trip. The hotel holds the room for their arrival.
A restaurant may save a table for guests at a chosen time. The guests give their name when they arrive. The arrangement helps them plan their evening.
The noun can also mean a doubt or concern about a plan. Someone may like most of an idea but worry about its cost. That concern can make them hesitate.
I made a dinner reservation for four at the hot pot restaurant.
You must confirm your table reservation at least one day before dining.
The committee expressed strong reservations about the proposed budget cut.
I made an online hotel reservation for two nights in Kenting.
Because the seafood restaurant is very popular, making a table reservation is mandatory.
You can modify or cancel your booking reservation without penalty up to forty-eight hours in advance.
luggage
The bags and cases people take on a trip are called this. They may hold clothes and personal items. Travelers should keep important things close.
Airlines have rules about how much a person can carry. Labels help bags get back to their owners. Check the rules before traveling.
A suitcase is one piece, while this word can refer to all the bags together. A backpack may be part of it too. Pack only what is needed.
Weigh your luggage before heading to the airport.
The airline allows two pieces of checked luggage per economy passenger.
Porters helped carry the heavy luggage up to our hotel room.
cart
A small vehicle with wheels carries groceries or other items. Someone pushes it through a store. Keep it out of the way afterward.
A horse or another animal may pull this vehicle. It can carry farm goods. Strong wheels make it easier to move.
A computer shop may show a list of items someone plans to buy. The shopper checks the total before paying. A button removes items no longer needed.
Dad pushed the cart through the grocery store.
The farmer loaded apples onto a wooden cart.
I added a notebook to my online cart before checkout.
tag
A small label attached to an item gives its name, price, or details. Clothes often have one inside. Read it before washing the garment.
As a verb, it can mean touching another player in a game. A child may touch another player during the chasing game. Agree on safe rules first.
A sign may show information for a whole place, while this is often attached to one object. It can also refer to a chasing game. The sentence shows the use.
The price tag was still attached to the shirt.
The children played tag in the yard.
She tagged the photo with the place name.
toothbrush
A small brush with a handle helps clean teeth. People move it gently over each tooth. They use it with toothpaste and water.
Brushes have soft or firm bristles. A clean one should be stored where it can dry. Each person should have their own.
Cleaning teeth every day is part of good care. Replace worn bristles when needed. A clean brush works better.
Dentists recommend changing your toothbrush every three months.
An electric toothbrush removes dental plaque more effectively.
Don't forget to pack your toothbrush before going on vacation.
toothpaste
It is a soft cleaning product used on a toothbrush. People use it to clean their teeth and freshen their breath. It often comes in a tube.
Put a small amount of this minty paste on a brush before cleaning your teeth. Some kinds contain fluoride to help protect against cavities. Rinse your mouth afterward.
This product helps remove food and plaque from teeth. It may have a mint flavor and is squeezed from a tube. Use it with a toothbrush each day.
Squeeze a pea-sized amount of toothpaste onto the brush.
This fluoride toothpaste helps prevent cavities.
Buy a fresh tube of mint toothpaste from the supermarket.
shampoo
A liquid or cream used to wash hair is called this. People massage it into wet hair and rinse it out. Keep it away from the eyes.
The verb means to wash hair with the product. Some kinds are made for dry or curly hair. Read the label before use.
Soap can clean hands and body, while this product is made especially for hair. Conditioner is used afterward by some people. Rinse well.
This botanical shampoo smells like mint.
Wash your hair with anti-dandruff shampoo twice a week.
She prefers using silicone-free shampoo for healthier hair.
porter
This noun names a person who carries bags for travelers at a hotel or station. The worker may help guests reach their rooms. The job involves carrying items.
It can also mean a person who carries goods or luggage as a job. A traveler may pay the worker for help. The term is common in older stories.
In sports, the word can name a player positioned near the goal. Context determines whether it means a worker who carries or a sports position. The role depends on the game.
The porter carried our bags to the room.
A porter helped the traveler at the station.
The porter waited beside the hotel entrance.
check in
Use this phrase when registering at a hotel or confirming you are taking a flight. A guest may do it at the front desk. Online options are common.
At an airport, travelers confirm their trip and receive a boarding pass. Hotel guests give their details when they arrive. This completes their arrival registration.
A traveler may register at a hotel and receive a room key. Airline passengers can confirm their flight by phone. The phrase has both travel uses.
Guests can check in to their hotel rooms starting from 3:00 PM.
Arrive at the airport three hours early to check in for your international flight.
We used our mobile phones to check in online twenty-four hours before departure.
captain
A leader is in charge of a ship or airplane. They guide the crew. They check that everyone follows safety rules.
A sports team may choose one player to lead. That person encourages teammates. They speak with the referee when needed.
The leader helps make decisions during a trip or game. Experience can be useful. Listening to others is important too.
The captain steered the boat into the quiet harbor.
Our team captain thanked everyone after the final game.
The airplane captain welcomed passengers before takeoff.
sailor
This noun names a person who works or travels on a ship. Crew members help steer, care for equipment, or move cargo. Some serve in a navy.
A person on a ship may spend weeks at sea with a crew. Another might guide a small boat along the coast. The job requires learning how to stay safe on the water.
A passenger rides on a ship but does not work there. A captain leads the crew. The word can describe people on many kinds of ships.
The sailor tied the boat to the dock.
A sailor waved from the deck.
The sailor checked the ropes before leaving.
A piece of cloth shows a country’s colors. A school may raise one on a pole. A traffic signal can tell drivers what to do.
A nation may have a symbol with colors and shapes. People can wave it at a game. It can also mean giving a warning.
This cloth symbol may fly above a building. A person may hold one in a parade. It can stand for a country or group.
The flag waved in the wind.
Our school flag is blue and white.
The driver was flagged down by a police officer.
cabin
A small simple house or room can stand in a forest or near a lake. Travelers may sleep there. It offers shelter from weather.
The front part of an airplane or ship holds the people who control it. They watch instruments. They follow safety steps.
A wooden shelter in the mountains may have beds and a stove. Visitors bring supplies. They leave the place clean.
The spacious wide-body aircraft cabin features dynamic circadian mood lighting.
We rented a rustic wooden cabin nestled among the tall pine trees in the mountains.
The airplane cabin pressure is maintained comfortably at an equivalent altitude of 6,000 feet.
flight attendant
This airline worker helps passengers during a trip in the sky. They show people how to use safety equipment and may serve drinks. They work inside the plane.
Before takeoff, this crew member explains important safety steps. During a journey, they help travelers find their seats. They may bring meals or tea.
A person with this job cares for passengers on an airplane. They answer questions and keep the cabin safe. The role includes serving food and drinks.
The flight attendant served hot tea and meal trays.
Friendly flight attendants ensure passengers understand safety evacuation procedures clearly.
She dreamed of becoming an international flight attendant and traveling globally.
The attentive flight attendant assisted elderly passengers with overhead bags.
Flight attendants undergo rigorous emergency evacuation and first aid training before flying.
The polite flight attendant brought a warm blanket and a glass of water to the shivering traveler.
overhead bin
It is a storage compartment above passenger seats on an airplane. Travelers place small bags inside. Open it carefully after landing because items may shift.
A cabin has these lockers over the rows of seats. A flight attendant may ask passengers to move bags if they are full. Keep heavy objects secure.
Passengers store carry-on luggage in this space above them. Put the suitcase in wheels first. Make sure it closes before takeoff.
Place your roller carry-on suitcase wheels-first into the overhead bin.
When the flight is completely full, flight attendants may ask you to check bags if overhead bins are packed.
Be careful when opening the overhead bin after landing, as heavy items might have shifted during flight.
headphones
This noun names a pair of small speakers worn over or in the ears. They let one person listen without playing sound aloud. They connect to a phone or computer.
A student may use them to hear a language lesson on a bus. Other passengers hear less noise. The device can be wired or wireless.
Different models cover the ears or fit inside them. They help people listen privately. The plural spelling is most common because the pair has two sides.
Sound designers use open-back reference headphones to evaluate subtle stereo panning and spatial reverb tails.
Commuters put on noise-canceling headphones to enjoy podcasts in quiet serenity on the crowded metro.
Studio tracking sessions require closed-back headphones to prevent headphone audio bleed into the open vocal mic.
Noise-canceling headphones help you concentrate in noisy cafes.
He placed his over-ear headphones on the desk after the podcast recording.
Wear stereo headphones to appreciate the subtle details of classical music.
magazine
A book comes out regularly with stories and pictures. A person may read one at a doctor’s office. It can have many pages.
A monthly publication may share news or fashion. A shop sells it. A reader may collect old issues.
This printed book has articles and photos. It can be published each week or month. People may read it for fun.
English learning magazines are very helpful.
She subscribed to a monthly science magazine for young readers.
You can flip through magazines while waiting in the dental clinic.
This English learning magazine features interesting cultural stories.
She subscribed to an interior design magazine to gather home decorating ideas.
The doctor's clinic waiting room provides current news and science magazines.
wing
A bird uses this body part to fly and keep balance. Feathers cover it. Moving it up and down pushes air.
An airplane has a part with the same name on each side. These parts help lift it into the sky. Pilots check them carefully.
A building may have a side section extending from the main part. A hospital can have one area for children. Signs guide visitors.
The bird hurt its wing and could not fly far.
A small plane lifted its left wing above the trees.
The children's wing of the hospital has bright wall pictures.
engine
A car has a machine that makes it move. It uses fuel or electricity. A mechanic may fix it.
A plane has a powerful part that moves it forward. A small machine can run a pump. The word means a machine that provides motion.
This machine turns fuel into movement. It can be found in a car or boat. A driver starts it with a key.
The mechanic checked the car engine thoroughly.
Strange rattling noises came from the old aircraft engine.
Turn off the engine while waiting at the railway crossing.
The blue-glowing xenon ion engine produces gentle, continuous thrust for years using solar electricity.
Multiple Hall-effect thruster engines fired in sequence to steer the robotic asteroid redirect spacecraft.
Operating the high-efficiency ion engine requires only a few grams of inert noble gas per day.
The 300kW fuel cell engine powers forty-ton semi-trucks easily up steep mountain highways.
The certified mechanic repaired the automobile engine after diagnosing a cracked cylinder head gasket.
Technological innovation serves as the primary engine driving economic productivity and job growth nationwide.
narrow

This adjective describes something with little space from side to side. A road, hallway, or opening may be difficult to pass through when it has this shape. It can also describe a small difference or limited choice.
Two cars may need to slow down on a road between tall walls. A person carrying a wide box might have trouble getting through a small doorway. Careful steps help in a tight space.
A word meaning “wide” describes the opposite shape. A path can be long and still have little side-to-side space. It can also describe a close victory when the score difference is small.
The narrow bridge let only one person cross at a time.
We walked along a narrow path beside the garden.
Our team won by a narrow margin.

newEntryJobs.text: baggage cart
This low wheeled trailer carries luggage around an airport.
Airport workers load suitcases onto this cart and move them to or from an airplane.
A small powered vehicle can pull this luggage trailer across the airport apron.
The worker puts two suitcases on the baggage cart.
A baggage cart waits beside the airplane.
The tug pulls a baggage cart across the airport.
business class
This airline travel class usually offers more space and services than economy class.
Passengers in this cabin often have wider seats and more room for their legs.
This is a premium seating class on an airplane, between economy class and first class when all three are offered.
Our business class seats have wide armrests.
She chooses business class for the long flight.
The flight attendant serves a meal in business class.
economy class
This is the standard seating class on a passenger airplane.
Seats in this cabin are usually arranged in rows with less space than business class.
This airline travel class usually costs less than business class.
Our family sits in economy class.
Economy class has rows of passenger seats.
He watches a film in economy class.
